name: rail
description: The spiral binding down the paper's left edge. Decorative, aria-hidden, no tap area, never navigation; every screen. Positioned in the shell and welded to the page: at tablet it follows the centred page, at desktop it sits at the title block's edge (--title-w), on iOS it stops at the tab bar.

a11y.keyboard: none: never focusable, never a target

responsive.700: left: centred with the page, calc((100% - --rail - --page-w) / 2) (revision 19)

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css A3 (.rail) and the website preview's rail rules.

catalogue.note: The rail is absolutely positioned and fills its container top to bottom; the frame stands in for the shell.
